title: Build Notes Feature
description: Build a complete Notes feature inside the existing application
goal: Build a complete Notes feature inside the existing application at /Users/shanaypatel/Documents/after-youv2Feature Requirements:1. Analyze existing codebase before making changes.2. Create a detailed implementation plan.3. Break the work into logical tasks.4. Execute each task using the appropriate tools.5. Create any required files and modify existing ones.6. Verify every change before marking it complete.Feature Requirements:- Create a new /notes page using Next.js App Router- UI must be consistent with the existing design system (dark theme CSS variables from workspace.css: --bg: #0c0d10, --surface: #14161b, --surface-2: #1a1d24, --accent: #c8a46b gold, --success: #6ed9a4, --danger: #ff7979, --blue: #8db7ff, font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif)- Display a list of notes with title and preview snippet- Include a search bar that filters notes by title/content- Add a 'New Note' button that creates a note using a modal or inline editor- Create reusable NoteCard and NotesList components in components/notes/- Update navigation so /notes is accessible (add a simple nav bar or update layout with nav links)- Use plain CSS (no Tailwind) matching workspace.css design tokens- Run 'npx next build' after all changes to verify no errorsFirst analyze existing code patterns:- Read app/layout.tsx to understand root layout patterns- Read app/workspace.css for design tokens- Read components/missions/ for component patterns- Check if there is any existing navigation
